title: Ada and the Ghost
author: August Galloway
blurb: Sebastian Okonkwo, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
